subject: Re: Accelerator pricing playbook & credit-bundle framing
messages:
From: Alice Moreno <alice@brightlabs.io>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 9 May 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Accelerator pricing inquiry — cohort credits + bulk seats

Hi Irene,

Thanks for taking the time on the demo yesterday. BrightLabs is putting together an AI-integration pilot for our startup cohort (10 teams, roughly 3 seats per team). We loved Redwood's latency profile and the sandbox experience. A few things we need to understand before committing to a pilot: 

- Can you outline how accelerator/free credits are applied when teams convert to paid (any time limits or carve-outs)?
- Is there a simple way to purchase a cohort bundle (bulk seat discount + pooled credits) vs. individual seats?
- Would Redwood consider a promotional exception for a first-cohort pilot — e.g., additional credits or a temporary lower per-token tier for the first 90 days?

If possible, can you send an example pricing playbook or a short matrix (ranges for 30/90/180 day pilots) so we can present to our ops and legal teams? We have a tight timeline (decision by May 20).

Appreciate it — happy to loop legal if you need contract-friendly language.

Best,
Alice
Alice Moreno
Head of Programs, BrightLabs

[Attachment: cohort_overview.pdf (stub)]

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Alice Moreno <alice@brightlabs.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 9 May 2026 15:02:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Accelerator pricing inquiry — cohort credits + bulk seats

Hi Alice — great to hear the demo landed well. Quick answers below and attaching a first-pass matrix. Ben and Kim are looped for pricing and accounting constraints.

Short answers: 
- Credits: accelerator credits apply as a prepaid pool to the account and can be consumed by any seats under the cohort umbrella. Standard expiry is 180 days; for pilot cohorts we can extend to 365 on a case-by-case basis. Any conversion to Reserved/Dedicated requires a conversion agreement (see matrix).
- Bulk seats: we do offer cohort packages (bulk seat SKUs) with stepped discounts at 10+, 25+, and 50+ seats. Credits can be combined with a cohort bundle but we apply a minimum commitment for discounts.
- Promotional exception: we can propose a one-time promotional sweetener (extra credits or a temporary lower per-token bucket) — needs Sales + Finance sign-off.

Attached: accelerator_pricing_matrix.xlsx (draft) and a sample SOW template called BrightLabs_SOW-draft.docx.

Next steps: Ben, can you propose two packaged options (conservative + aggressive) we can surface to BrightLabs this afternoon? Kim, flag any accounting / tax notes that would prevent the credit extension.

Thanks — Irene
Irene Choi
Head of Growth, Redwood Inference

[Attachments: accelerator_pricing_matrix.xlsx (xlsx), BrightLabs_SOW-draft.docx (docx)]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Alice Moreno <alice@brightlabs.io>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 09:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Accelerator pricing inquiry — cohort credits + bulk seats

Hi Alice — following up with two options per Irene's ask. Quick note: both options assume a pilot start by June 1 and a single invoice for the cohort owner. We can adapt billing to individual teams if needed, but price changes slightly.

Option A — Conservative (low upfront risk)
- 10 seats (up to 3 dev seats per team), 6-month pilot
- Base per-token tiers: standard hosted rates (no per-token discount)
- Included credits: 100k tokens pooled (consumable by cohort), expiry 180 days
- On conversion to paid: credits applied pro-rata to first invoice, no refund for unused credits
- No minimum committed spend; volume discount kicks in at conversion stage
- Price: USD 6,500 one-time cohort setup + usage billing

Option B — Aggressive (conversion-focused)
- 30 seats, 6-month pilot (BrightLabs cohort program)
- Base per-token tiers: 10% reduced per-token for pilot duration (applied to host tier)
- Included credits: 300k tokens pooled, expiry 365 days
- Promotional exception: additional 50k onboarding credits if signed by May 20
- Minimum committed spend on conversion: $25k/quarter for 2 quarters to maintain discount
- Price: USD 22,000 one-time cohort setup (includes onboarding and SRE hours)

Notes & asks (to internal):
- Kimberly: confirm whether the extra 50k onboarding credits are allowed as a promo and any tax/accounting implications for cohort grants.
- Irene: if BrightLabs signals prefer Option B, I recommend we draft a short appendix to the SOW with the conversion mechanics and reversal/fallback clauses.

Alice, happy to jump on a 20-minute call if you want to walk through the options.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

[Attachment: OptionComparison_short.pdf (stub)]

From: Alice Moreno <alice@brightlabs.io>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 11:21:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Accelerator pricing inquiry — cohort credits + bulk seats

Thanks Ben — this is exactly what we needed. Quick internal notes: 
- Our ops prefers Option B but legal wants the conversion appendix and clarity about unused credits (they push for a 12-month expiry on the credits).
- Can you confirm whether the 10% pilot discount can be time-limited (90 days) instead of the full 6 months? That would help our CFO greenlight it.
- If we sign by May 20, we will accept the 50k onboarding credits; please confirm in writing (legal will need it).

Irene — can you share the SOW appendix draft once Ben/Finance confirm wording? Also cc'ing our legal alias: BrightLabs Legal <legal@brightlabs.io> for contract coordination.

Regards,
Alice

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 14:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Accelerator pricing inquiry — cohort credits + bulk seats

Looping in final finance constraints and approval.

- Promo credit policy: Finance can approve a one-time 50k onboarding credit for marketing/sales-led pilots if the deal is recorded in HubSpot and a short promo appendix is attached to the SOW. We treat these as marketing credits (no cash value on our books) and must have a sponsor code for ledger tracking.
- Expiry: We can make exception to 365 days for the pilot credits, but 12 months for the onboarding add-on requires an approval ticket; recommend 365 for simplicity.
- Discount time-limits: We prefer to keep pilot discounts explicit in the appendix; making the 10% discount time-limited to 90 days is doable. Note the conversion-triggered minimums still apply if they convert within the 90-day discounted window.

Action items: Ben — please create a HubSpot deal record ID and attach the SOW+appendix. Irene — once Alice confirms Option B + May 20 sign, we will route the promo approval and create the sponsor code.

Kimberly Park
Director, Revenue Finance, Redwood Inference

[HubSpot Deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/BR-12345]
